title: What is new in codechart 0.8.0
summary: codechart now explains a change to people who don't read code, lets reviewers leave notes right on the page, and compares what was built with what was planned.

sections.title: A page for product owners
sections.summary: On request, the agent writes a plain-words page of a change: what people will experience, which rules change, and what the business now keeps. The owner answers its questions without opening the repo.

now.text: Developer explains the change in a call
Owner asks for the rules in writing

after.text: Owner reads the stories, rules and questions
Owner presses Yes or No on what the agent only guessed
Owner sends the answers back in one paste

rules.name: Plain words only
rules.after: The page shows no code, file names or technical names. A sentence that looks like code is refused before the page is made.

rules.name: Guesses are marked
rules.after: Anything the agent worked out from names and structure, instead of reading the code, is marked and waits for the owner's yes or no.

sections.title: Notes on the page
sections.summary: Reviewers can write a note on any box, line or arrow of the page, then copy all of them to the agent in one go.

journeys.name: Reviewer leaves notes for the agent

now.text: Reviewer writes comments in a separate chat
Agent guesses which box each comment is about

after.text: Reviewer writes a note on the exact box, line or arrow
Reviewer copies every note with one click
Agent reads each note with its place

rules.name: Late replies still count
rules.after: A reply pasted days later is still understood, as long as the page was made in the last 30 days.

sections.title: Review from the terminal
sections.summary: Reviewing in the terminal now works the same way as on the page, so notes written in either place reach the agent together.

rules.name: Same notes everywhere
rules.before: Notes from the terminal and from the page were kept apart.
rules.after: Both kinds of note are listed together, each with the box it belongs to.

data.name: Review notes
data.what: Each note, the box it is about, and whether the agent has read it
data.why: So nothing is lost when the page is redrawn

sections.title: Plan versus what was built
sections.summary: A finished summary was sometimes compared with a plan that came after the work started. It is now compared only with a plan that existed before the work began.

rules.name: Only an earlier plan counts
rules.before: Any saved plan on the branch could be used for the comparison.
rules.after: A plan is used only if it was made before the first change it is compared with.
